status: Diagnostic checkpoint only; reject runtime rollout of this prototype. No production code changed.

reference.inspiration: Group compatible rigid parts while retaining each part pose identity; authored smooth skinning was not implemented in the reference.

scope.geometry: One bone per original body part with weight 1. No smooth weights. Keep authored EIAnimPart nodes and original interpolation-before-composition. Copy tangents/normals/UV/indices; group exact material/layer/shadow mode. Keep head/attachments/morphs and translucent wisp separate.
scope.views: Eight figures, two camera/pose states, idle/walk/attack/death when present. Second state rotates figure, enables detailed head and applies native wounds. Sixty views per broad suite.
scope.timing: 32 manually animated human figures, 512x512 offscreen world, original/merged/merged/original, 160 measured samples per case after warmup. Normal frame loop; no force_draw/readback in measurement. Options plus engine cap/VSync disabled and asserted. Linux RTX 3090, desktop backends. No AI/network/full map/shadow workload.
scope.acceptance: Checks assert geometry/expected bypass and timing configuration, not pixel equality or gameplay readiness.

verdict.renderer_correctness: All 180 independent-original control pairs are exact. Candidate broad views show sparse residuals, up to 9/12/13 pixels above 2/255 on Compatibility/Forward+/Mobile; precise cause unproven. Twelve-point-light Compatibility case changes up to 14738 pixels above 2/255 versus at most one with four lights. Per-instance light scoring depends on the mesh centre; source support in renderer_scene_cull.cpp:3049.
verdict.picking: Exact production rectangle query confirms merged rectangles turn loose union hits into high-priority part hits. Up to 41902 viewport pixels change classification for the human fixture. Preserve logical per-part rectangles before integration.
verdict.performance: Uncapped original and merged frame medians respectively: Compatibility 1.637-1.641 vs 1.687-1.707 ms; Forward+ 1.452-1.483 vs 1.539-1.582 ms; Mobile 1.358-1.371 vs 1.471-1.521 ms. Palette sync adds 0.257-0.268 ms in this crowd. No performance gain or device/FPS claim. Cold build totals include asymmetric first asset warmup and are not comparable.
